say:0:1510643001:1.text: The massive mural before you is falling apart, but you can still make out shapes in the parts that remain intact.
say:0:1510643001:1.source_cn: 眼前的巨大壁画破损不堪，剥落了许多碎片。幸运的是，得以...

say:1:1510643002:1.text: Your eyes are drawn to the large piece missing from the center. You can just make out faint, golden, cone-shaped patterns radiating from the edges of the hole. The empty space... it looks like a perfect fit for the stone tablet you're carrying.
say:1:1510643002:1.source_cn: 在中间破损处的边缘，依稀可以看到一些金色的锥形向外伸展...

say:2:1510643003:1.text: Maybe you should see if it fits.
say:2:1510643003:1.source_cn: 也许你该将它拼上去试试。
